name: Storm Release: Dance of Mirrors and Lights

sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Lightning Release, Reezaa Branch

system.description:
As part of casting this jutsu, you must have at least 2 or more creatures marked as a Refraction Point.

You fire off a cascade of lightning beams that curve, bend and strike at each creature. Make a single ranged Ninjutsu attack, comparing the result vs the AC of each creature marked as a Refraction Point¸ in range, dealing 4d10 lightning damage on a hit. If you score a hit on at least 2 creatures, make another ranged Ninjutsu attack targeting the same creatures, dealing 3d10 lightning damage on a hit. If you score a hit on at least 4 creatures this time, make another ranged Ninjutsu attack, targeting the same creatures, dealing 2d10 lightning damage on a hit. If you score a hit on at least 8 creatures this time, make another ranged Ninjutsu attack, targeting the same creatures, dealing 1d10 lightning damage on a hit.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the damage by 1d10.
